title: Licensed under the baseline's library combo
body: The user's three-tier model: GPL-3.0-only with the Open Project Exception, OR the Royalty-Free License (closed-source applications under USD 1,000,000 revenue, with attribution, not SDKs or embedded), OR a commercial agreement. LICENSE.md, LICENSES/ and REUSE.toml are rendered from vg-paradigms' licensing (pinned at 06444df); every manifest says `GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-Royalty-Free-1.0 OR LicenseRef-Commercial-1.0`. Contributions come in under MIT-0 with a DCO 1.1 sign-off and a patent grant, replacing the CLA and its CLA Assistant workflow. Dependency licenses are judged by tend check against the combo (cargo-deny keeps advisories, bans and sources; MPL-2.0 blocks nothing). The non-GPL texts are drafts until a lawyer reviews them (baseline warning license.reviewed).
